correctness.rationale: For simple Hermitian spectrum with nonzero flat absorber overlaps, the non-Hermitian generator has strictly negative spectral real parts. The Lyapunov equation for the integrated maximally mixed density is solved entry by entry; cancellation of all three-index rational fractions yields exactly N/kappa+(2 kappa/N^2) sum_{j<k} (E_j-E_k)^(-2), with a sharp unique convex optimum. A Walsh basis gives the binary cube signed-sum spectrum, binary weights 2^i remove all degeneracy for 0<epsilon<(2^d-1)^(-1), and equal-cardinality spectral pairs alone determine the epsilon^(-2) and optimized epsilon^(-1) leading laws. Exact rational checker substitutes the complete constructed X into all Lyapunov entries for seven concrete spectra, solves the full system independently in three cases and verifies C2,C3,C4 and small cube spectra. Sampling is not substituted for the universal proof.

value.rationale: The unconditional capture time and optimal absorber strength are physically and mathematically motivated observables. The proof works for every flat-simple local spectral measure, far beyond a single small graph. In the natural all-dimensional binary cube, any nonzero specified bond anisotropy eliminates a large dark subspace but induces a sharp and quantifiable divergent time cost, with distinct exponents for fixed and optimized absorber rates. The new invariant C_d is motivated by the actual near-degenerate Walsh energy shells, not by arbitrary finite slicing.
